cases.name: root-python-startup
cases.note: Unchanged Base plus a startup hook. A trusted root interpreter must never execute candidate sitecustomize; process exits 0 before any required checks if it does.

cases.name: alternate-dense-cache
cases.note: Preserved historical positive control: dense runtime cache is larger than its compact profiling allocation. Newly covered profiling requirement reveals an independent underestimation; patch bytes unchanged.

cases.name: dense-cache-missing-cold-window
cases.note: Previously accepted dense alternative; incomplete when scheduling skips a cold masked item.

cases.name: empty-placeholder-omission
cases.note: Previous compact Oracle: asserts on an empty placeholder inside a scheduled window.

cases.name: empty-window-admission
cases.note: Preserved previous Oracle blocks a cold empty window with insufficient encoder capacity or budget.

cases.name: forged-completion
cases.note: Preserved fixed completion report; no target behavior executed.

cases.name: stale-observations
cases.note: Replay a genuine successful pilot observation payload without executing the current workload.

cases.name: lookahead-omission
cases.note: Preserved prior Oracle handles low-resource empty windows but skips encoder output required by EAGLE lookahead, including mask-free inputs.

cases.name: alternate-distinct-profile-accessors
cases.note: Preserved historical source: distinct accessors are valid, but the Qwen3-VL direct estimate retains the 12.5x prompt expansion; actual scheduler and runner capacities are incorrect.

cases.name: scheduler-capacity-from-context
cases.note: Correct registry and cache accounting, but scheduler capacity wrongly uses decoder context length.

cases.name: runner-capacity-from-context
cases.note: Correct scheduler and registry, but runner capacity wrongly uses decoder context length.

cases.name: alternate-distinct-profile-accessors-video-fixed
cases.note: Historical distinct-accessor implementation plus the missing video estimate correction; preserves its alternative interfaces and representation.

cases.name: alternate-hash-only-batching
cases.note: Coherent batching-helper return refactor from (hash, position) tuples to hashes; scored tests must execute the real producer rather than impose historical private return values.

cases.name: alternate-dense-profile-consistent
cases.note: Historical 1.3.4 positive. The 1.4.0 contract additionally forbids encoder payload growth with non-embedding prompt positions; dense storage is now a negative. Patch bytes remain unchanged.

cases.name: alternate-zero-output-capacity
cases.note: Allow zero global encoder capacity when all modality output upper bounds are zero; nonempty planning and zero-budget prompt advancement remain checked.

cases.name: alternate-renamed-helpers
cases.note: Renames encoder batching, execution, gather and scheduler admission helpers and all production callers; no behavioral change.

cases.name: alternate-transposed-payload
cases.note: Stores a contiguous transposed encoder payload and restores its orientation at consumption; storage layout and allocation lifetime differ.

cases.name: wrong-main-window
cases.note: Preserves the gather helper but shifts its production main-model caller by one prompt position.

cases.name: historical-astra-video-estimate
cases.note: Unchanged production edits from the attached Astra/high 1.2.8 answer; its dummy path works but Qwen3-VL analytical estimates retain the 12.5x prompt expansion.

cases.name: preallocated-dense-payload
cases.note: Dense cache reserves its backing pool in the runner constructor. Profiling covers that pool; payload growth must still be rejected after it receives encoder data.

cases.name: alternate-constructor-state
cases.note: Adds per-runner encoder-read accounting initialized by the real constructor; no output change.

cases.name: alternate-runner-buffers
cases.note: Renames runner model and input-buffer storage plus in-repository worker consumers; stable load/get/execute APIs retain the same behavior.

cases.name: alternate-sparse-payload
cases.note: Stores encoder rows as a sparse COO tensor with separate value/index storage, and profiles the same representation; downstream input values are unchanged.
